PROP-01b-partial3-inv-042.text: Donation attack: direct underlying transfer to market must not inflate exchange rate for attacker.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-042.assertion: forall market m: exchangeRate computed from getCash (balance check) not manipulable by donation

locations.note: Uses self.cash (tracked internally, not balance()) in cash_plus_borrows_minus_reserves. However, deposit_underlying syncs self.cash with actual balance — so direct coin transfers bypassing deposit_underlying would NOT update self.cash, making exchange rate immune to donations
Only way to update self.cash is via this function; direct external transfers to the Balance object do not update self.cash — key donation attack mitigation
